verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents remote view and control, and a heavy daily user reports keyboard handling working well (no NumLock bug). That same user reports alt-tab problems from Linux to Windows, and no evidence describes how mouse, keyboard and scroll are injected as native events on the host. missing for 10: first-party documentation of native input injection, evidence for scroll and mouse fidelity, reliable key-combo forwarding across OSes (alt-tab issue).
